title: Phenyl selenoxide functionalized TPA/TPE π-conjugated imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine: a fluorescent probe for the selective detection of water in organic solvents
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44205-44212
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07283B, Paper

Jerome Issac, R. Rameshbabu Priyadharsan, Kamalanathan Chidambaranathan, Subramanian Karthikeyan, Dohyun Moon, Savarimuthu Philip Anthony, Vedichi Madhu
Phenyl selenoxide functionalized tetraphenylethylene (TPE) and triphenylamine (TPA) π-conjugated imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine based donor–acceptor systems were synthesized and utilized for water sensing.
